info.title: v2.shop_flash_sale.update_shop_flash_sale_items
info.description: edit shop flash sale item, you can only edit the models in disbaled or enabled status

post.description: edit shop flash sale item, you can only edit the models in disbaled or enabled status

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: input_promo_price
parameters.description: promotion price without tax if the model is enabled(status = 1) now, you can't set this field, you can only disable the model if the model is disabled(status = 0) now and you want to set this field, you should also set status to 1

parameters.name: item_input_promo_price
parameters.description: The promotion price of the item. If the item has no variation, you can use this field to update the promotion price of the item, otherwise don't use this field if the item is enabled(item_status = 1) now, you can't set this field, you can only disable the item if the item is disabled(item_status = 0) now and you want to set this field, you should also set item_status to 1

parameters.name: item_status
parameters.description: The status of the item. If the item has no variation, this param is necessary, otherwise don't use this field you can use this field to set the status of item 0: disable 1: enable

parameters.name: item_stock
parameters.description: min=1, The campaign stock of the item. If the item has no variation, you can use this field to update the campaign stock of the item, otherwise don't use this field if the item is enabled(item_status = 1) now, you can't set this field, you can only disable the item if the item is disabled(item_status = 0) now and you want to set this field, you should also set item_status to 1

parameters.name: model_id
parameters.description: If the item has variation, this param is necessary.

parameters.name: models
parameters.description: If the item has variation, this param is necessary, otherwise please don't use this field

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: purchase_limit
parameters.description: min=0, 0 means no limit if the item is in enabled status or the item has models in enabled status, you can't set this field

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: you can use this field to set the status of model 0: disable 1: enable

parameters.name: stock
parameters.description: min=1, Campaign Stock, Campaign stock can only be reserved from either Shopee stock or Seller stock if the model is enabled(status = 1) now, you can't set this field, you can only disable the model if the model is disabled(status = 0) now and you want to set this field, you should also set status to 1

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.
